name: assertIntegerish
title: Returns the value when it is a vector of numbers within tolerance of integers

origin.description: Returns the value when it is a vector of numbers within tolerance of integers. Otherwise it stops with the check message.
origin.usage: assertIntegerish(x, tol = sqrt(.Machine$double.eps), lower = -Inf, upper = Inf, any.missing = TRUE, all.missing = TRUE, len = NULL, min.len = NULL, max.len = NULL, unique = FALSE, sorted = FALSE, names = NULL, typed.missing = FALSE, null.ok = FALSE, coerce = FALSE, .var.name = vname(x), add = NULL)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Value under test. A Python int is an R integer and a Python float is an R double.

arguments.name: tol
arguments.text: How far a number may sit from an integer.

arguments.name: lower
arguments.text: Lower bound, inclusive.

arguments.name: upper
arguments.text: Upper bound, inclusive.

arguments.name: any.missing
arguments.text: When false, any missing value fails the check.

arguments.name: all.missing
arguments.text: When false, a completely missing value fails the check.

arguments.name: len
arguments.text: Required length.

arguments.name: min.len
arguments.text: Minimum length.

arguments.name: max.len
arguments.text: Maximum length.

arguments.name: unique
arguments.text: When true, duplicate values fail the check.

arguments.name: sorted
arguments.text: When true, the values must be in non-decreasing order.

arguments.name: names
arguments.text: Labels used when a combined assertion fails.

arguments.name: typed.missing
arguments.text: When true, a missing value must already have the requested storage mode.

arguments.name: null.ok
arguments.text: When true, NULL is allowed.

arguments.name: coerce
arguments.text: When true, a passing double is rounded and stored as integer.

arguments.name: .var.name
arguments.text: Name used in the assertion message.

arguments.name: add
arguments.text: Collection that stores the message instead of stopping.

origin.details: Returns the value when it is a vector of numbers within tolerance of integers. Otherwise it stops with the check message.
origin.value: The value when the check passes. Otherwise the check stops.
